thread:
rachel: Found a reproducible bug in the Next hybrid starter when using ephemeral tokens for edge streaming.

mike: What happens exactly?

rachel: If the ephemeral token rotates while a stream is active, the JS SDK retry reopens the stream with the old Authorization header and the connection stalls. Python client resolves auth per-retry and doesn't show the issue.

tara: Minimal repro from the template: 

```
// edge/api/stream.js
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const ephemeral = await exchangeEphemeral(req.cookies.sid);
  const stream = await redwood.stream({ model: 'redwood/fast-13b', prompt: req.body.prompt, token: ephemeral });
  stream.pipe(res);
}
```

jon: Any logs?

rachel: Yep: 
```
[2026-03-24T09:11:01Z] exchange token id=tmp-42 ttl=20s
[2026-03-24T09:11:18Z] token rotated id=tmp-43
[2026-03-24T09:11:19Z] sdk retry attempt=1 using Authorization: Bearer tmp-42
[2026-03-24T09:11:19Z] stream stalled waiting for CHUNK_END
```

mike: Clearly the SDK captured the header at open time. Proposed: accept an authResolver callback in JS client that is invoked on each request/retry to fetch fresh headers. Keep fallback to static key for compatibility.

tara: Also add a unit/e2e test that simulates rotation mid-stream and asserts the retry sends newly-resolved auth. We lack coverage for ephemeral flows in streaming tests.

jon: Short-term workaround for the starter: do the ephemeral exchange server-side and return a one-time signed URL or have the browser request a fresh token immediately before opening the stream. Document both patterns in the starter README under "Edge auth patterns."

rachel: I'll open a PR to update the starter README and include an authResolver example snippet. If the client change lands, we can patch the template to prefer authResolver.

ci-bot: CI started for branches fix/js-auth-resolver + update/starter-readme  4 checks queued. :ci:

mike: I'll prototype the authResolver API: { auth: async () => fetch('/api/ephemeral').then(r=>r.json()).token } and wire it into retry logic.

tara: Thanks — this will improve onboarding for demos/labs using ephemeral sessions. Share any additional repros (cookie stores, Vercel edge, self-hosted) here.
\rachel: :thumbsup:
